integrity: The proof is self-contained modulo the published closed formula for the leading coefficient and the classical Hermite--Lindemann theorem. The finite computation is a stress test only and is not used to infer the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Exact injectivity only. No quantitative separation or finite-precision stability bound is proved, and no extension beyond the quasi-homogeneous family \(M_{k,\ell}=[z^k-w^\ell]\) is claimed.
title: The leading tail coefficient alone determines the quasi-homogeneous exponents
